code.title: Project code
code.about: Code repositories the engine learns from how the system is built. Clones live in Code/, read-only, and do not go into the project's git; the list is kept in the project settings, and every member gets the same clones.
code.load_failed: The section did not load — open it again.
code.empty: No repositories yet. Paste a git clone line above — the repository appears here, and "Sync" puts its clone into Code/.
code.conflict: The repository list was changed elsewhere while the form was open (another tab, git pull, a hand edit). Take what is on disk or write yours over it.
code.save_failed: Not saved — fix and save again:
code.add.title: Connect a repository
code.add.about: Paste the whole line from the repository page (the Clone button): the engine reads the server, the address and the branch. Any provider fits — GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea or your own server.
code.add.secret_moved: The address held a password: it is moved into the field below and does not go into the project settings.
code.field.name: Folder name
code.h.name: The clone goes to Code/<name>. Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore — the name must work on Windows, macOS and Linux.
code.h.url: No login or password: sign-in is set below and kept outside the project.
code.h.pin: A SHA or a tag. Empty — the clone follows the branch; set — it stays at this revision until changed.
code.h.include: Path masks, comma-separated, to count as code even if skipped by default (for example vendor/our-library/**).
code.h.exclude: Path masks, comma-separated, not to count as code: generated, foreign, large.
code.h.access: How the repository is reached: the connection check does not start the sync while the connection is down and names the reason.
code.h.auth.system: Sign-in git already knows on this machine (credential manager, ssh-agent).
code.h.auth.token: A personal token allowed to read the repository.
code.h.auth.password: A login and password or an app password.
code.h.auth.ssh: An SSH key: path to the file on this machine.
code.h.user: Most servers need a login with a token; GitHub and GitLab do without it.
code.h.user_bitbucket: bitbucket.org: the user name (not the e-mail) — the one in the clone line.
code.h.secret: Kept outside the project, in a protected file on this machine; only a mask goes out.
code.h.secret_bitbucket: bitbucket.org: an API token allowed to read repositories.
code.h.secret_keep: The token is saved. Empty — keep it; a new one replaces it.
code.h.ssh_key: For example ~/.ssh/id_ed25519; its public part must be in the profile on the server.
code.auth.system: As git is set up on this machine
code.secret_set: saved — type a new one to replace it
code.perm.models: Code may be given to models
code.perm.models_hint: Off — neither assistants nor task attachments see the files of this clone. Off by default.
code.perm.publish: Artifacts about this code may be published
code.perm.publish_hint: Descriptions built from the code go to Confluence only with this mark. Off by default.
code.check.ok: The connection works: branches on the server {n}.
code.check.empty: The connection works, but the repository is empty.
code.last_bad: The last sync at {when} failed ({code}) — the reason is in the Console.
code.dirty: Edits in the clone: {n}. The clone is read-only — "Reset the clone" returns it to the server; the code is edited in its own repository.
code.foreign: The clone folder holds another repository. If the address changed, "Reset the clone" points the clone to the address in the list.
code.long_paths: The clone's longest path does not fit on Windows without long paths — check kit:paths.
code.no_stats: Languages and size appear after the sync.
code.size: Files in the repository {files}, code {counted} ({size}), other {other}
code.reset_ask: Reset the clone "{name}"? Edits and extra files in its folder will go: the clone is read-only, the code is edited in its own repository.
code.remove_ask: Remove "{name}" from the repository list? The clone folder stays on disk: delete it yourself if it is no longer needed.
code.err.name_long: the name is longer than 64 characters
code.err.name_chars: only Latin letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore; starts with a letter or a digit, does not end with a dot
code.err.name_reserved: the system reserves this name — choose another
code.err.name_duplicate: a repository with this name already exists (case does not matter)
code.err.bad_url: the address is wrong: https://server/owner/repository, git@server:owner/repository or a path
code.err.no_url: the line holds no repository address
code.err.creds_in_url: the address holds a password — remove it from the address and enter it in the sign-in field
code.err.branch: a branch cannot be named like this
code.err.pin: a SHA (7–40 characters) or a tag name is needed
code.err.mask: a mask cannot start with "/" or a drive and cannot go up with ".."
code.err.access: connection mode: empty, internet, local or vpn:<profile>
code.err.multiline: the value must fit on one line
code.err.key_format: this is not a private SSH key
code.err.missing: the file is not on this machine
code.err.required_for_token: this server needs a login with the token
code.err.bad_expect: the page sent a wrong snapshot — open the section again
code.err.bad_repos: the page sent a list of the wrong shape — open the section again
code.err.config_encoding: aurora.config.yaml is not UTF-8 — the file is left as it is
code.p.auth: The server did not accept the sign-in — check the login and the token (or password): the token may have expired or lack rights to the repository.
code.p.forbidden: The sign-in is accepted, but there is no right to read the repository — ask its owner for access.
code.p.network: The server is unreachable — check the network, VPN and the address; try again later.
code.p.repo_not_found: The repository is not found on the server — check the address. For a private repository this also means "no right to read".
code.p.remote_branch_missing: The server has no such branch — check the Branch field or leave it empty.
code.p.cert: The server certificate did not pass the check — trust in a certificate is set in the "Git" section (the "Trust the certificate" button).
code.p.ssh_key: The server did not accept the SSH key — add its public part to your profile on the server or choose another key.
code.p.ssh_hostkey: The server presented an unknown SSH key — compare the fingerprint with the administrator.
code.p.no_git: git is not installed on this machine — the Install page tells how to put it in.
code.p.code_dirty_clone: The clone has edits — "Reset the clone" returns it to the server.
code.p.code_foreign_clone: The clone folder holds another repository.
code.p.code_pin_absent: The pinned revision is not on the server — check the SHA or the tag.
